channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Dominique Wilkins | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Dominique Wilkins from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Gail Goodrich on Michael Jordan, Dominique Wilkins
item.description:
Goodrich said of the competition.

“They both performed with excellence. I thought that Michael performed just a little bit ahead of Dominique. I cast my vote for Michael.”

Gail Goodrich on Michael Jordan, Dominique Wilkins, Feb 14, 2020. Source: TSN.

item.title: Allonzo Trier on Dominique Wilkins
item.description:
“He just gave me some respect. A great honor to hear that from a legend like Dominique.”

Allonzo Trier on Dominique Wilkins, Oct 18, 2018. Source: Twitter @MikeVorkunov.

item.title: Michael Reinsdorf on Dominique Wilkins
item.description:
Vincent Goodwill:Michael Reinsdorf on if MJ won the 88 dunk contest:

“There’s no doubt that Michael won that dunk contest. The only person who doesn’t think he won it was Dominique Wilkins... And anyone from Detroit.”

Michael Reinsdorf on Dominique Wilkins, Nov 10, 2017. Source: Twitter @vgoodwill.

item.title: Master P on Dominique Wilkins
item.description:
Master P's no stranger to making his own footwear, and he even had a few NBA contracts in the late '90s, but truth be told, this idea seems like it came out of nowhere.

“I'm working on something right now, real soon, the Dominique Wilkins shoes,”

Master P on Dominique Wilkins, Jun 22, 2016. Source: Sole Collector.

item.title: Nate Robinson on Gerald Green, Dennis Rodman, Julius Erving, Dominique Wilkins
item.description:
“A guy like Gerald Green controls his hops and his jumps are for a purpose. Julius Erving had big hands. He was always moving the ball all around; he made it look like magic in the air. Then you have explosive dunkers who jump high and dunk hard like Dominique Wilkins. Me? I'm an energy jumper. My jumping ability is more like an explosive Dennis Rodman, and since I'm shorter, it looks crazy. I'm just a guy out there who's trying to show the world what I can do. Not too many 5-9 guys can dunk like I can.”

Nate Robinson on Gerald Green, Dennis Rodman, Julius Erving, Dominique Wilkins, Jan 18, 2013. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Rick Mahorn on Dominique Wilkins
item.description:
Mahorn said Thursday when reached on his cellphone.

“We all have mental lapses, but you don't take your frustration out in a way that will hurt somebody. I didn't have the physical gifts or the flight of a Dominique Wilkins. I used my body and my width to position. I would use my big (butt) to clear some room.”

Rick Mahorn on Dominique Wilkins, Nov 9, 2012. Source: Sacramento Bee.
